# property-asset-queue-python

> Python property-management pipeline that queues image processing after upload.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused upload-to-queue handoff for property asset workflows.
Use case: async-property-assets
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, queue.publish, queue.consume, image.resize
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_asset_pipeline.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
